title: Pilot compatibility with different classes of UAP

tellings.quote: I might work very well with object A but I can't work with object B or C.

plain: A man who goes only by Jordan says a secret UFO program took him as a child, around 2008 to 2010, at a place in New York called Baker Victory Services. He says the program was testing which craft each person could work with. UAP is the government's term for unidentified anomalous phenomena, or UFOs. In his words, "I might work very well with object A but I can't work with object B or C," which would mean these craft somehow match up with particular pilots.
